id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_150.pack|cs_:
"You have resolved yourself, {var:1}.
  Then I will tell you
  all that I know.

"When you break Time's Sphere,
  what you can carry to the past
  is likely...

"the record of your adventure,
  which is as your memory...

"and the battle experience
  you have gained thus far...

"only what is in the Timeless Vault
  circling the Altar of Time.

"...The Timeless Vault is the only thing
  in the world that can travel back
  in time with you.

"When you break the Sphere, your items
  and bag contents will enter
  this Timeless Vault...

"and it will carry what you need
  for your adventure ahead
  to the past.

"The Sword of Light you now wield
  may shatter along with the Sphere...

"but you should have the Sword of Shadows,
  which once was the Sword of Light.

"Use that for a while
  in battle.

"That is all I know.
  When you are ready to depart for the past,
  come before Time's Sphere...
